body.purpose: Profile, work history, navigation, and contact details in DM Sans.

motion.name: editorial-enter
motion.purpose: One-time hero entrance and section reveal; disabled by prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: interaction
motion.purpose: Quiet link, button, and navigation feedback.

components.name: Primary CTA
components.description: Light editorial button used for the main contact action on navy.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; min-height:48px; align-items:center; padding:0 20px; background:var(--paper); color:var(--navy); font:600 13px/1.4 var(--sans); text-decoration:none; transition:background 200ms ease,transform 200ms ease; } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--paper-white); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-button:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--coffee); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Section Navigation
components.description: Sticky, text-led navigation for moving through the profile.
components.html: TentangPengalamanKeahlian
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:32px; } .ds-nav a { color:var(--navy-soft); font:500 13px/1.5 var(--sans); text-decoration:none; text-underline-offset:5px; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:var(--coffee-ink); text-decoration:underline; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--coffee); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Experience Row
components.description: Open ruled row with title, employer, plain description, and supplied duration.
components.html:
01

Barista · Angkringan Pusat

Pengalaman di bidang pelayanan.

10 bulan
components.css: .ds-experience { display:grid; grid-template-columns:32px 1fr auto; gap:12px 20px; align-items:center; padding:22px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule); color:var(--navy); } .ds-experience span { color:var(--coffee-ink); font:600 12px/1.4 var(--sans); } .ds-experience h3 { margin:0; font:400 24px/1.2 var(--serif); } .ds-experience p { grid-column:2; margin:0; color:var(--ink-soft); font:400 14px/1.6 var(--sans); } .ds-experience strong { grid-column:3; grid-row:1/3; font:400 17px/1.4 var(--serif); }

components.name: Contact Link
components.description: Direct external contact destination with a clear text action.
components.css: .ds-contact { display:flex; min-height:64px; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule); color:var(--navy); font:400 22px/1.2 var(--serif); text-decoration:none; } .ds-contact small { color:var(--ink-soft); font:500 12px/1.4 var(--sans); } .ds-contact:hover { color:var(--coffee-ink); } .ds-contact:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--coffee); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview: A personal hospitality profile shaped like a considered magazine page. Navy carries the professional identity, warm paper makes the story comfortable to read, and coffee photography brings context without claiming to depict Ivan.
keyCharacteristics: Coffee imagery is not personal evidence

rules.name: One Accent Rule
rules.body: Coffee brown stays a small marker for active details and dividers.

rules.name: Evidence Rule
rules.body: Every profile claim must come from facts supplied for Ivan.

dos: Use serif display type with DM Sans for reading.
Keep photography local and list its source and license.
donts: Do not invent dates, certificates, projects, or proficiency levels.
Do not present stock photographs as Ivan or his workplace.
Do not add developer-portfolio conventions or skill percentage bars.
